scope: Deterministic DevelopAccelerator interface fault contracts plus existing actual Metal numerical tests; no windows
contracts: Unavailable backend returns the exact CPU geometry/RGBA and every histogram field, with clipping overlay enabled, for neutral and Noise/Sharpen/Crop/Exposure documents.
Short/long buffers, backend exceptions and cancellation after backend entry reject without returning partial pixels; exact actionable messages checked (8 cases).
Subsequent renders recover exact CPU output; source RGB and alpha remain unchanged.
Existing 13 actual Metal cases and 2 explicit combined-Curve/HSL CPU fallbacks still pass unchanged fixed numerical budgets.
limits: Injected interface return values/errors are not actual MTLCommandBuffer, driver, allocation or device failures.
The bounded synthetic input is 257x193 with HDR/negative values and fractional alpha; no RAW, stress, memory-pressure, latency or hardware-UI claim.
No official phase 0.6 UX ID or full release gate is marked passed by this unit test.
Blocking clang-tidy checks pass; non-blocking optional-access warnings remain behind throwing require preconditions.
